title: "will" in questions
text: What will you/we/they/he/she do to take care of the Earth?
: Yes, ________. We'll do some shopping in the new supermarket.
: We'll buy some vegetables, eggs and fish.
: OK. I'll take a cloth bag. ________ Dad go with us too?
: No, ________. He'll stay at home and do some chores.
: We'll go on foot. It's good for us.
: And it's good for the Earth too!
